entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [iOS 26+] Secondary toolbar overflow ("...") button gets Shell.ForegroundColor while the primary items do not, since 10.0.120 (regression from #36821) #40495
  • [iOS 26+] FontImageSource toolbar icon is drawn 3.8 pt above center since 10.0.120 (regression from #39230) #40494
  • [BlazorWebView][Windows] .mjs static files are served as application/octet-stream, so ES module scripts fail to load #40493
  • [aw] Daily Memory Leak Hunter reported incomplete result #40491
  • [Android] Back press closes the app after a TabbedPage tab switch: predictive back callback not refreshed on tab change #40490
  • [iOS] Reading UIView.Interactions in GesturePlatformManager can make UIKit interactions dealloc on the finalizer thread #40489
  • [repo-status] Daily status — 2026-11-21: cross-platform fixes and SR2 follow-through #40488

Closed

  • [repo-status] Daily Repo Status — 2026-11-20 #40460
